title: Ticket tests of the paper on a second TLS library (Go crypto/tls): client window (stage C) and the ticket written with the server's first flight (stage D), predictions from the calibrated write pattern
serves: limitation of the paper: one TLS library
stages: custom: run_testbed.py --profile core --resume with PQC_PROBE=tls_probe_go; the cells of results/g10_go_cells.json, grouped by (request, response)
status: criteria H1-H5 in results/g10_go_predictions.md, fixed on 2026-11-19, before the measurement; any machine
notes: Needs the Go probe on the machine: testbed/build_go_probe.sh (Go >= 1.27; --install-go downloads it). run.sh checks that the write pattern of the probe on THIS machine equals the calibrated one (go_calibrate.py --check, tolerance 16 B) before measuring. Analyse with testbed/analyze_g10.py.
